description: Pinned third-party sources, licenses, and adaptations used for Section 6.6 comparison benchmarks.

components.name: LIBSVM
adaptations: Portability adjustments for SGX enclave compilation (remove unused file model I/O and stdio fprintf calls, forbid unseeded rand paths) recorded in 6.6-comparison/common_svm/svm.cpp.
Common exp dispatch hook (work2_exp_fn / work2_probe_exp) for the controlled Section 6.6 comparison recorded in 6.6-comparison/common_svm/solver-dispatch.patch.

components.name: PrivacyGuard
components.license: Upstream repository does not include a standalone LICENSE file; upstream archive is fetched on demand rather than redistributed in Git.
adaptations: third_party/privacyguard/t1-adapter.patch: CEE DataOwner/iDataAgent benchmark harness, buffer/hash length fixes, error propagation, and HW non-debug build configuration.

6.6-comparison/common_svm/privacyguard-exp.patch: Direct patch from prepare_privacyguard_t1.py (--flavor benchmark) to the Section 6.6 common-exp SVM CEE enclave/host build (applied together with 6.6-comparison/common_svm/ C++ files).

components.name: VDDPI
components.license: Upstream repository does not include a standalone LICENSE file; upstream archive and CPython 3.6.9 wheels are fetched on demand rather than redistributed in Git.
adaptations: third_party/vddpi/patches/01-correctness.patch: Certificate CN binding, quote length check, usage-condition failure propagation, and post-expiry cache removal.
third_party/vddpi/patches/03-task.patch: Common C++ LIBSVM task library integration via plib.py.
third_party/vddpi/patches/04-interpreter.patch: Hash-checked CPython 3.6.9 entry point adaptation for Gramine 1.9.
